programs.notes: CICS online account-update program. Touches ACCT-ID through four distinct copybook aliases (ACCT-ID via CVACT01Y, CC-ACCT-ID via CVCRD01Y, CDEMO-ACCT-ID via COCOM01Y, and XREF-ACCT-ID structure via CVACT03Y though XREF-ACCT-ID itself is never named individually — the CARD-XREF-RECORD is read as a whole block). The account ID drives the RIDFLD on three separate CICS READ calls and is ultimately written into ACCT-UPDATE-ID for the REWRITE. CARDDEMO-COMMAREA containing CDEMO-ACCT-ID is passed via COMMAREA on CICS XCTL at line 958.

programs.notes: CICS online card-update program. Does NOT actively COPY CVACT01Y or CVACT03Y (both commented out). Reaches the target field via three routes: (1) CVCRD01Y / CC-ACCT-ID used as search key, validation subject, screen display source, and source for CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID in the REWRITE; (2) COCOM01Y / CDEMO-ACCT-ID read from and written to the inter-program commarea; (3) CVACT02Y / CARD-RECORD read structurally into INTO(CARD-RECORD) but CARD-ACCT-ID is never individually addressed — the program reads only the non-ID card fields (CVV, name, expiry, status). CC-ACCT-ID-N is moved into CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID before the CICS REWRITE, making this program a writer of the account ID into the card file. CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is passed via COMMAREA on CICS XCTL at line 475.
